description:
• Manage and develop customer accounts, including key customers while expanding business with existing customers and acquiring new accounts.
• Plan and execute sales activities to achieve assigned sales targets, promote company cutting tools, and expand market coverage among precision machining companies.
• Conduct regular customer visits within assigned territories by motorcycle or car to introduce products, understand customer requirements, provide suitable solutions, and identify new business opportunities.
• Monitor market trends and competitor activities to identify business opportunities and recommend appropriate sales strategies and pricing.
• Prepare quotations, negotiate pricing and commercial terms, and follow up on sales opportunities to achieve business objectives.
• Prepare regular sales reports, participate in weekly sales meetings, and support account planning and sales strategy development.
requirements_text:
• Graduated from higher in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Economics or other related majors.
• Having at least 1 years of sales experience
• Experience in the cutting tool industry or related fields (e.g., CNC machines, coolant for precision machining) is an advantage.
• English communication skills are required.
• Negotiation and B2B communication skills.
• Ability to work under pressure, independently, and in a team.
• Ambition to develop skills and career.
• Car driving license is an advantage (company provides cars for business trips).
